name: Groza

skills.name: Fire Command
skills.description: Selects 1 target within 7 tiles, dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of attack.

skills.name: Heavy Suppression
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 7 tiles, dealing Physical damage equal to 130% of attack, and applies Movement Down II to them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Perfect Cover
skills.description: Applies 2 stacks of Shelter and Defense Up II to all allied targets within 6 tiles for 2 turns. Gains 1 point of Confectance Index for each allied target within range. Increases the Counterattack count by 2 for the turn.

skills.name: Explosive Bombardment
skills.description: Select 1 tile within 7 tiles of the user to launch an attack, dealing AoE Physical damage equal to 90% of attack to all enemy targets within a 3x3 area and applying Movement Down II for 1 turn.

skills.name: Timely Maintenance
skills.description:
when an allied unit (excluding this unit) ends their action within 7 tiles, gains 1 point of Confectance Index and applies 1 stack of Shelter to both the allied unit and this unit. For each stack of Shelter, Groza's damage increases by 5%.

If an enemy within 6 tiles deals Targeted damage to an allied unit, Groza launches a Counterattack, dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them, as well as 4 points of Stability Damage. This can be triggered at most once per turn.

fortification.effect: If this skill causes the enemy to enter into Stability Break, the user gains 1 point of Confectance Index and recovers 4 points of stability index.
When Groza's action ends, applies Attack Down I on the enemy with the highest ATK within a 7 tile radius of self for 1 turn.
Extends the duration of Movement Down II increases by 1 turn.
When having Shelter, reduces stability damage taken by 1 point.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Multidimensional Assessment
keys.effect: When the user causes the enemy to enter into Stability Break, applies Defence Down I and Attack Down I on the enemy for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Controlled Advance
keys.effect: When using Perfect Cover, additionally applies Attack Up I for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Adaptive Strategy
keys.effect: When self HP is below 30%, increase healing received by 50%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Firepower Superiority
keys.effect: If Heavy Suppression causes the enemy target to enter Stability Break, applies Taunt to them for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Sustainable Operations
keys.effect: When the user is under the effects of Shelter, reduces AoE damage taken by 20%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Principles of Evasion
keys.effect: When Groza enters into Stability Break, restore 20% of self max HP, 5 points of stability index, and cleanse 4 debuffs from self. Triggers only once per battle.

keys.name: Common Key - Sustained Endurance
keys.effect: HP +3.0% / When Shelter is active, immune to displacement for 1 time. Has a cooldown of 1 turn.

keys.name: Expansion Key - Absolute Defense's Essence
keys.effect: When using the active skill Perfect Cover, gains Absolute Defense.
